improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
improve.coach: 62% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
improve.coach: It's come up in 33% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Never gets old, and I hope it never does. 71% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You touched the ball more than a nervous waiter touches a menu. 48% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: That's what I call neighborly football. Shows up in 48% of your matches. That's a calling card.

coach.intro: Pull up a chair, BellyTb1. 21 matches of evidence, and I've got thoughts.
